title: Head of Enterprise Data
description:
Head of Enterprise Data – London / Birmingham (Flexible hybrid working) | Full-Time / Permanent 

Up to £105k (depending on experience) + bonus and excellent benefits including healthcare, wellbeing support, 27 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, life insurance and more. 

We're looking for an experienced Head of Enterprise Data to join the digital & technology team at Compass Group UK & Ireland - a global leader in food services. This is an opportunity to lead data management across Compass Group UK&I's enterprise estate, ensuring data is trusted, well-governed and accessible to support strategic decision-making and business growth. 

As Head of Enterprise Data you'll report into the Chief Data and Analytics Officer, acting as the enterprise data design authority, shaping data architecture, governance, master data management and quality improvement across a complex organisation.  

This is a unique opportunity to influence an AI-first transformation and deliver lasting business impact. 

Compass Digital & Technology is where ideas turn into possibilities.  

We’re the technology team behind Compass Group UK&I, part of Compass Group, one of the world’s largest hospitality businesses. We’re shaping the next generation of products, platforms and experiences for Compass Group, harnessing AI to create competitive advantage and accelerate growth. 

We create, manage and deploy technology which supports our operators, clients and guests. From enterprise-scale cloud engineering, cybersecurity, mobile ordering and guest-facing experiences to everyday IT support. Our work reaches across our business and all walks of life, from schools to banks and into the daily lives of millions of people.

But D&T is about more than technology. It’s a place to be curious, challenge what’s possible and turn great ideas into real outcomes. A place where talented people collaborate, experiment, learn and make an impact at scale.  

We own it from idea to outcome. We challenge what’s possible. And together, we’re creating better solutions, every day. 

Head of Enterprise Data – The role 

  • Lead enterprise data management across Compass Group UK & Ireland, integrating data architecture, governance, master data management and data quality disciplines. 
  • Act as the enterprise data design authority, providing architectural direction, standards, assurance and governance across the enterprise estate.  
  • Develop and maintain enterprise data models, integration patterns, governance frameworks and reusable data standards.  
  • Lead and develop a specialist team including the Data Governance Manager, Data Quality Manager and Data Solutions Architect.  
  • Drive data quality improvement initiatives, ensuring critical data risks are identified, owned and resolved with measurable outcomes.  
  • Establish effective data stewardship, ownership and change control processes across the business.  
  • Collaborate with architecture, product, platform and business leaders to ensure consistent and effective use of enterprise data.  
  • Champion enterprise-wide data standards while balancing business needs, innovation and delivery priorities.  

What we're looking for 

  • Strong expertise in enterprise data architecture, including domain models, canonical models, integration patterns and architectural governance.  
  • Experience operating master data management and data governance frameworks at enterprise scale.  
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive behavioural change across business, technology and product teams.  
  • Experience leading specialist data teams and creating high-performing, collaborative cultures.  
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to different audiences. 
  • Proven ability to drive data quality improvement and establish effective governance practices.  
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with practical delivery in a complex organisation.  

What you'll get in return 

  • Competitive salary with bonus and full company benefits 
  • 27 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, your birthday off, and a holiday purchase scheme 
  • Healthcare & wellbeing: Aviva Digicare, Medicash (dental, optical, therapy treatments) 
  • Mental health support: 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme 
  • Family benefits: Enhanced maternity, paternity, and adoption leave. 2 days' additional leave after returning from maternity leave, day off for your baby's first birthday, enhanced family leave 
  • Perks & discounts: Shopping, entertainment, and travel discounts, 20% off Nuffield Health and 10% off PureGym memberships 
  • Financial wellbeing: Pension scheme, Life Assurance, preferred rates on salary finance products 
  • Development opportunities: Professional subscriptions, ongoing training and structured career pathways 

Compass Group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
